Services  /  Strategy & Operations

How technology should fit the way you actually run.

What this looks like

Advising engagements are often a single session plus a written summary.

  • Aligning your systems with your actual daily workflows, rather than forcing your team to adapt to the software
  • Policies and governance: acceptable use, data handling, access, and who decides what
  • Technology planning and roadmaps, sized to a budget you actually have
  • Reviewing a quote or proposal from another vendor before you sign it
  • Technology assessments for boards, funders, and lenders, and requirements for public bids

What you walk away with

A recommendation, in writing

With the reasoning shown, so you can defend it to a board or a partner.

Options, honestly priced

Including the option of doing nothing yet, when that is the right answer.

No lock-in

You can take our plan and have anyone execute it. That is a feature.

Maine technology consulting for small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies.
